title: Building Bridges
about: Composed by the women of the Greenham Common peace occupation, England, 1983; transcription used by permission of Elizabeth Cave (per the book). It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #198, printed page A(39), PDF p.29 (typeset, 4-part round).
melody_note: Encoded by eye from the songbook’s typeset notation (book A #198, printed page A(39), PDF p.29 — a four-line round in four flats, transcription credited to Elizabeth Cave). Draft reading — verify against the book page.
verdict: Verdict: pending. Typeset source is cleaner than the hand-drawn pages, but pitch-level confidence still moderate. The round is widely published (Rise Up Singing) for an independent check.
